newsitem.title: USA: Republic, FFO Financial to merge.
newsitem.headline: Republic, FFO Financial to merge.

text.p: FFO Financial Group Inc said Tuesday that is has executed a letter of intent with Republic Bancshares Inc for the combination of the two companies.
William Hough, a director of FFO, owns a controlling interest in both companies.
Republic would exchange 0.29 share of Republic common stock for each of the 8.43 million outstanding shares of FFO common stock, FFO said.
FFO said it would have the right to terminate the agreement if the average of Republic's stock price were less than $13.50 shortly before the closing.
Outstanding options for FFO common stock would be converted into options for Republic common stock on the same basis.

The transaction would be accounted for as a corporate reorganization under which the controlling shareholder's interest in FFO would be carried forward at its historical cost while the minority interest in FFO would be recorded at fair value, FFO said.
